newsitem.title: CHINA: Anex issues convertible note to Heng Fung.
newsitem.headline: Anex issues convertible note to Heng Fung.

text.p: Electrical appliances maker Anex International Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to issue a HK$40 million convertible note to third party Heng Fung Holdings Co Ltd.
The note will have a maturity of 36 months from the date of issue and will carry an interest rate of seven percent per annum payable semi-annually, Anex said in a statement.
It said the note would also carry a right to convert into Anex shares at an initial subscription price of HK$0.65 each subject to adjustment.
Anex said it would be required to issue 61.54 million new shares, or 14.67 percent of its enlarged share capital, on full conversion of the note.
The net proceeds of HK$39 million raised from the note issue will be used to repay a term bank loan, with the balance for working capital, it said.
Anex shares edged down HK$0.01 to HK$0.70 in mid-morning.
